probes.name: baseline-and-executable-contracts
probes.instructions: Review only the original migration plan and this frozen repository baseline. Do not read Claude review results, implementation ledger, implementation PR, docs/port/red-team-research, or comparison research notes; do not seek other refs or private history. The plan is its own decision source, an implementation plan with future files expected absent. Honor its broad mechanism latitude. Missing linked evidence is a coverage gap, not a plan defect. No implementation, plan repairs, external actions, or Phase 3. Covers claims-vs-reality, executable-proof, dependency-feasibility; bespoke baseline-repro and command/floor contracts. Read named baseline constructs: canonical red-team scaffold/gate/escape guard, Snipe process/model/package helpers, WAR phase succeeded state, resolveGate and test/packaging floors. Verify existing claims against source. Execute bounded independent fixtures/current relevant tests for disputed assumptions, especially stated override globs and dependency semantics; keep legitimate controls and actual outputs. Never run missing future acceptance files as alleged defects. Do not execute outward authoring delivery. Falsify candidates before reporting; expected observation is existing interfaces permit this plan within its latitude, or a demonstrated concrete contradiction.
